original_problem: Prove x^2 + 1 >= 2*x for every real x.

candidate.proof: 1. Let x be an arbitrary real. 2. (x-1)^2 >= 0. 3. Expanding gives x^2 - 2*x + 1 >= 0. 4. Hence x^2 + 1 >= 2*x.
